product.name: 4K60 Video Extender with HDMI up to 70m Over a Single CAT6/6a Ethernet Cable
product.description: Monoprice™4K60 Video Extender with HDMI® and IR Control, Up to 70m Over a Single Cat5e/6/6A CableExtend 4K HDMI video and IR signals up to 70 meters over Ethernet cableExtend your Ultra HD 4K HDMI®‑equipped display device over standard Ethernet cable up to 230 feet, with zero latency.The 4K60 Video Extender with HDMI enables the transmission of Ultra HD video signals and IR control signals up to 70 meters over a single Cat5e, Cat6, or Cat6A cable. The high‑resolution, uncompressed video makes it an ideal solution for extending displays in A/V systems, where the receiver and video components are mounted in separate areas. Additionally, it is highly effective for use in digital signage systems, such as restaurant menu boards, hospitality displays, educational facilities, and corporate conference rooms.This device facilitates the transmission of stunning 4K video and audio signals up to 70 meters with zero latency and uncompressed quality. It supports resolutions up to 4K60Hz 4:4:4, delivering vibrant color and exceptional clarity, thereby enhancing the viewing experience.Furthermore, the EDID® copy pass‑through function simplifies device and display compatibility. The extender also features bi‑directional IR, which allows equipment control from either end and PoC (Power‑ over‑ Cable), reducing cable clutter and providing convenient power distribution.Enhance your audiovisual setup with this reliable and high‑performance technology.Extend 4K HDMI® video up to 70 meters over a Cat5e/6/6A cableSupports full 4K@60Hz resolution at 12‑bit 4:4:4 and HDCP™ 2.2 as specified in HDMI 2.0b18 Gbps bandwidth supporting up to 4K60Supports HDR, HDR10LPCM, Dolby Atmos/Digital/Plus/Ex, Dolby True HD, DTS, DTS‑HD Master AudioPass‑through EDID ensures seamless compatibility between sources and displaysBi‑directional IR control signal pass‑throughSupports PoC (Power‑over‑Cable) function from Transmitter to Receiver GOING THE DISTANCEThe extender offers an impressive transmission distance of up to 70m/230ft, ensuring reliable signal delivery without any noticeable latency. It combines advanced technology, such as uncompressed transmission and EDID copy pass‑through, to provide a seamless extender solution. VIVID VIDEOEnjoy stunning video quality with support for up to 4K2K@60Hz resolution, HDR, and HDR10. The extender supports various video codecs, including RGB/YCbCr 4:4:4, and offers a wide range of color spaces and color depths for vibrant and lifelike visuals. IMMERSIVE AUDIOExperience true high‑quality audio with support for LPCM 7.1, Dolby True HD, DTS‑HD Master, Dolby 5.1, DTS 5.1, and PCM 2.0 audio formats. The extender also features ARC to SPDIF audio extraction. CONTROL FREAKTake full control with bi‑directional IR control signal pass‑through, allowing seamless control of connected devices. The extender provides flexibility and convenience in managing your audiovisual setup. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x 4K Video Transmitter• 1x 4K Video Receiver• 1x IR Emitter• 1x IR Receiver• 2x Velcro Strips• 1x Power Adapter (12VDC, 1A)• 1x User Manual Support Files: Manual (Jan 22, 2026)Tech Drawing (Jun 3, 2026)Sales Sheet (Jun 5, 2026)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
